_comment: Classical mode: three candidate explanations of an observed invariant, each as a predictive distribution over a probe's finite outcomes. `structure` and `proxy` are truth-indistinguishable under THIS probe (trace distance ~ 0) though they have different source maps -- a probe-gap. The instrument quantifies the indistinguishability (total variation = classical trace distance), reports the best single-shot Helstrom discrimination, the Chernoff exponent (how many blind bearings separate a pair), and the most-discriminating outcome to look at next.
